about_the_game:
🧩 Welcome to Your Forever Home

Abandon all hope. You've clipped through the cracks of reality and fallen into the Backrooms—an infinite, decaying labyrinth of offices, corridors, and spaces that should not exist. Backrooms: Eternals is not just a game; it's a living, breathing simulation of the internet's most terrifying collective nightmare, built with uncompromising fidelity to the original lore.

This is a place where the laws of physics have dissolved into the nauseating hum of fluorescent lights and the damp smell of old carpet. Your only goal is to survive. Your only enemy is eternity itself.

🌟 KEY FEATURES

  THE ULTIMATE CANON EXPERIENCE

  • This is the Backrooms as they were meant to be experienced. Every level, entity, and object is meticulously recreated from the original canon. No creative liberties. No compromises. Just pure, unfiltered dread.

  AN EVER-EXPANDING LABYRINTH

  • Your journey begins on the iconic Level 0, but it is far from over. We are committed to building the most complete Backrooms universe. Through major, free updates, we will systematically introduce new, faithful levels—from the pitch-black terror of Level 6 to the mind-shattering paradox of Level ! and beyond. The maze is alive, and it's growing.

   A MENAGERIE OF TERROR

  • You are not alone. Face off against a roster of entities ripped straight from the pages of the wiki. Learn to fear the skittering of Facelings, the distorted screams of Hounds, and the soul-crushing gaze of a Smiler. They are not monsters to be killed; they are forces of nature to be avoided at all costs.

  SURVIVAL OF THE SANEST

  • This is true survival horror. Manage your sanity, thirst, and exhaustion. The environment itself will break you. The constant hum will lull you into madness, and the silence will scream. Scavenge for precious resources like Almond Water to keep your mind from shattering.

  NO HAND-HOLDING, ONLY DESPAIR

  • There is no quest log, no objective marker, no friendly guide. Your story is written by your discoveries, your choices, and your inevitable demise. Will you search for a way out, or will you delve deeper into the abyss in search of answers?

  NEXT-GEN ATMOSPHERIC HORROR

  • Powered by Unreal Engine 5, experience the Backrooms with stunning, photorealistic fidelity. Dynamic lighting and state-of-the-art sound design create an atmosphere so thick with dread you can almost smell the stale carpet.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4430
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Latest drivers for AMD and NVIDIA GPUs are required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 8GB / RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space

short_description: Backrooms: Eternals is not a game. It's a relentless, ever-expanding simulation of the ultimate horror: an infinite reality, stripped of all meaning. There are no goals, only survival. No hope, only the decaying echo of what was once reality. Welcome to your forever home.

English*, Spanish - Spain
